prompt:
A sailing vessel traveled along a coastal route at an average speed of $13.450$ leagues per hour. What was the average speed, in yards per hour, of the vessel along this route? ($1$ league $= 2,640$ yards)

$$0$$

$$35508$$
explanation: The correct answer is $35508$. It's given that $1$ league $= 2{,}640$ yards. It follows that an average speed of $13.450$ leagues per hour is equivalent to $\left(\frac{13.450 \text{ leagues}}{1 \text{ hour}}\right)\left(\frac{2{,}640 \text{ yards}}{1 \text{ league}}\right)$, or $35{,}508$ yards per hour.
